display.purpose: Greeting headline on Home screen. One instance per screen. Never reused for secondary headings.

headline.purpose: Section titles, modal headers, document type labels in templates. Always uppercase in app chrome contexts.

title.purpose: Action card labels, form section headings. Outfit family.

body.purpose: All running text, card subtext, receipt content rows, UpgradePrompt descriptions. Inter family.

label.purpose: Form field labels, nav labels, status badges, section separators. Always uppercase, always tracking-widest.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Cards on Home and History screens at rest. Nearly invisible — depth hint, not anchor.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Applied on :hover for interactive cards. Lifts card to confirm interactivity.

shadows.name: fab-glow
shadows.purpose: Orange-tinted glow under the FAB. The only coloured shadow in the system.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Modal panels and the UpgradePrompt bottom sheet.

shadows.name: button-primary
shadows.purpose: Primary CTA buttons. Moderate lift that grounds the button.

motion.name: spring-standard
motion.purpose: Default spring for modals and overlay panels (scale + opacity + y).

motion.name: spring-snappy
motion.purpose: UpgradePrompt bottom sheet slide-in from bottom.

motion.name: ease-colors
motion.purpose: All colour state transitions (hover, active) on buttons, inputs, and nav items.

motion.name: scale-press
motion.purpose: active:scale-95 (buttons, FAB) and active:scale-[0.98] (CTAs) and active:scale-[0.99] (inputs). Present on every interactive element.

breakpoints.name: app-container
breakpoints.purpose: The only layout constraint. Content is centred at max-width 480px on all viewports. No responsive layout changes — the product is designed for one column.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Used only in UpgradePrompt to switch from bottom-anchored sheet (items-end) to centred modal (items-center).

components.name: Text Input

components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; width: 100%; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #616161; padding-left: 4px; } .ds-field-wrap { position: relative; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #eeeeee; border-radius: 16px; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #212121; outline: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #bdbdbd; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #e8590c; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(232, 89, 12, 0.1); } .ds-input:active { transform: scale(0.99); }

components.name: Segmented Control

components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; padding: 8px 16px 24px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-nav-pill { max-width: 480px; margin: 0 auto; height: 64px; position: relative; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border: 1px solid rgba(238,238,238,0.5); border-radius: 32px; box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-around; padding: 0 8px; pointer-events: auto; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px; color: #9e9e9e; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item.ds-nav-active { color: #e8590c; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #616161; } .ds-nav-fab { position: relative; top: -24px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-fab { width: 56px; height: 56px; background: #e8590c; border-radius: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: white; box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(232,89,12,0.4); outline: 4px solid white; transition: transform 150ms ease; } .ds-fab:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

narrative.overview:
Proofa's visual identity is built for speed, trust, and mobile authority. Every design decision is made in service of a single moment: a WhatsApp seller filling in a form while the customer is waiting, then tapping Share and watching a professional document land in the chat. The system is optimized for that 45-second interaction window — no decoration that slows comprehension, no detail that earns a second glance at the wrong moment.

The palette is a study in contrast without complexity: a single Burnt Orange accent that carries full brand authority, a Rich Charcoal that anchors dark document headers, and a disciplined greyscale that runs the surfaces. Orange earns credibility — it signals energy, premium attention, and Nigerian market confidence without shouting. Charcoal anchors the Bold template and the FAB with quiet authority. The neutral surfaces (off-white to mid-grey) keep the focus on the user's content, not the chrome.

Typography leans heavy. Outfit at 800–900 weight for all headings; uppercase label text at 10px/900 weight with wide tracking for field labels, section markers, and metadata. Body copy in Inter at 500 weight — readable but never passive. Radius is consistently large (16–24px for inputs and cards, 32px for nav and modals), giving the entire product a rounded, approachable physicality that works well at thumb scale.
keyCharacteristics: Orange-dominant single-accent palette; never split the attention of the primary colour
Mobile-first container (max 480px) centred on all screen sizes
Uppercase tracking-widest labels throughout (field labels, nav items, status badges)
Scale-on-active feedback on every interactive element
Glass/blur header and bottom navigation with backdrop-filter: blur()
Framer Motion spring transitions for modals and sheet overlays
Dark charcoal (#1a1a1a) reserved for the Invoice document header panel only

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Orange (#e8590c) is the only coloured accent in the application chrome. No competing accent colours on backgrounds, borders, or icons. Semantic status colours live only in transient notification elements — never on persistent surfaces.

rules.name: The Uppercase Label Rule
rules.body: Every field label, nav label, and status indicator is rendered in uppercase with wide letter-spacing (tracking-widest, ≈0.1em). No label uses title-case or sentence-case. The uniformity creates instant scan hierarchy on a mobile screen.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate by luminance difference and border, not shadow lift. Shadows appear only as a state response (hover, active, floating) or on elements that genuinely float above the page.

rules.name: The No-Sharp-Corners Rule
rules.body: No element in the app chrome has border-radius: 0. Sharp corners are reserved for inside the exported document templates only — never in the app UI shell.

dos: Do use active:scale-95 or active:scale-[0.98] on every interactive element — buttons, cards, icon buttons, inputs.
Do render all form field labels in uppercase tracking-widest text-[10px] font-black text-surface-700.
Do use rounded-2xl (16px) as the default radius for inputs, buttons, and cards.
Do limit the orange accent (#e8590c) to primary actions, active states, focus rings, and brand identity elements.
Do use spring physics for all overlay transitions: type: spring, damping: 25–30, stiffness: 300–320.
Do use Framer Motion layoutId for animated state transitions between sibling elements.
Do apply glass-effect (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-12) for floating chrome elements above content.
Do follow the app-container constraint (max-width: 480px, padding-inline: 1.25rem) for all app-shell content.
donts: Don't use a second accent colour in the app chrome. Green, blue, purple, and teal belong only in transient semantic contexts.
Don't use border-radius: 0 on any app-shell element.
Don't use Rich Charcoal (#1a1a1a) as an app-shell background or surface colour — it is a document-template colour only.
Don't use title-case or sentence-case for labels, status chips, or nav items.
Don't use box-shadow for surface separation in resting state — use luminance difference and hairline borders.
Don't place primary CTA buttons above fold content — primary actions are always pinned to the bottom of the form/screen.
Don't use font weights below 500 anywhere in the UI.
